cohort: 1,964,523 primiparous women with singleton gestations in the US in 2011 to 2012
finding: Compared to women with an IDI of 18 to 36 months, both shorter and very long IDIs were associated with an increased risk of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with long interdelivery intervals had a higher risk of cesarean delivery compared to women with interdelivery intervals of 18 to 36 months.
